prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores 70 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: the share price is 74.4% higher than a year ago; over the past year the share did 76.1 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; and the share price is close to its 52-week high. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on price behaviour: the 3-year maximum drawdown was -55.8%, a deep fall. Also against it: one-year volatility is 54.6%, high; value scores only 30 of 100 against the comparison pool; and risk scores only 31 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: what the price asks for the earnings, risk, what the price implies.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 12 points in favour and 7 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 53 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Overweight with medium confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
